My name is Matheus Zaia Monteiro and I'm from Brazil. I'm a Bachelor in Science and Technology at ILUM School of Science, an institution linked to CNPEM. I'm currently a PhD student in Computer Science and Computational Math at ICMC-USP. 

This website contains some of my notes in areas I'm interested in, such as: Machine Learning, Deep Learning, Applied Math and applications of these areas in other scientific fields.
